other_conditions: The applicant must be a legal heir of the deceased worker.
The deceased worker must have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
The deceased worker may be either registered or unregistered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,00,000 is provided to the legal heirs of a construction worker who dies or becomes permanently disabled due to an accident at the work site.
